dedupe_keys.name: project information model resulting from the on site survey

description: ENCORE project partners deposit two IFC project-information models from residential-building renovation studies at a JEA experimental building in Cáceres, Spain. The models were assessed on site on 14 and 15 December 2021 with the project On-site Analysis and Verification Service, which uses mixed-reality surveys to identify constructability issues. Zenodo lists both public IFC files and an XML index under CC BY 4.0. A building modeller could reuse the IFC geometry and object structure as a case input for renovation phasing, asset checks or digital-twin simulations. The XML lists 33 object-linked audio comments, but the separate audio deposit is restricted, so those comments cannot be assumed accessible. This is a specific project model, not a measured energy-performance series or proof of construction outcomes. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these Cáceres IFC models. The IFCs were not downloaded or parsed; geometry, object GUIDs and consistency between the two files remain unchecked.
inputs: JEA experimental-building renovation survey and project data
